blocks.text: Arguments indeed are not derived from accent, neither in writings nor sentences pronounced, unless there may be a few, such as this argument, "Is τὸ οὗ καταλύεις a house?" yes! "Is not τὸ οὐ καταλύεις the negation τοῦ καταλύεις? yes! "But you said that τὸ οὗ καταλύεις was a house, therefore a house is a negation." How therefore the solution must be made, is clear, for "ου" does not signify the same thing, when pronounced more acutely, and when more gravely.
